title: First player's winning strategy
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a Boolean-valued winning condition $W$ on finite Boolean histories, the first player wins in $n$ steps if there is a strategy $s_1$ such that, for every strategy $s_2$ of the second player, $W$ evaluates to true on the play of length $n$ generated by these strategies.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued winning condition on finite Boolean histories
